title: Favorite Sports
source_credit: Original WorldVoice A1 learning dialogue · text-only; no voice recording has been published.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Hi, Adam. Do you like sports?
dialogue.translation_ar: مرحبًا يا آدم. هل تحب الرياضة؟

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, Lina. I play football every week.
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم يا لينا. ألعب كرة القدم كل أسبوع.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Do you play with your friends?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, we play on Friday evenings.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Is football your favorite sport?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, but I also like swimming.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: I like swimming too.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Can you swim very well?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Not very well. I am still learning.
dialogue.translation_ar: ليس جيدًا جدًا. ما زلت أتعلم.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Where do you take swimming lessons?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: At the sports center near my house.
dialogue.translation_ar: في المركز الرياضي القريب من منزلي.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: How often do you go there?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: I go there two times a week.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I prefer walking and riding my bike.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Do you ride your bike every day?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: No, only when the weather is nice.
dialogue.translation_ar: لا، فقط عندما يكون الجو جميلًا.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Would you like to play basketball?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes! I want to learn that too.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Let's play in the park tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Great. I will bring a ball.
